synopsis.summary: Accept bare section labels as aliases in splitInlineSections so skill-prose batches compile to four-file CU folders instead of silent legacy blobs (bug-3).

cus.content: ARCH rules for bugfix-feature-3 (bare section labels accepted as aliases). Hexagonal architecture: domain models in itrcompiler.domain.models; compile orchestration in itrcompiler.application.services; CLI parsing in itrcompiler.control.cli; filesystem access only via itrcompiler.infrastructure.filesystem. No cross-layer dependencies. Port flow outbound to inbound. The splitter lives in itrcompiler.infrastructure.parsers (JSONFormat.splitInlineSections) matching against the shared CU.sectionLabels list in the domain layer, so parser and validation agree by construction. New validation failures must be typed domain errors surfaced with the offending CU id and component name.

LEGEND for bugfix-feature-3. CU = Computational Unit. CU folder = per-CU subdirectory named after the CU id (e.g. cu-001/). COORDINATES.itr = DTR area affected/created by the CU. REQUIREMENTS.itr = what part of the feature the CU adds. IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS.itr = stepwise code instructions for the Coder (gitignored). ACCEPTANCE.itr = per-CU acceptance criteria + acceptance/regression tests. SYNOPSIS.itr = ITR-root file naming implemented features and defining MAX_ATTEMPTS. MAX_ATTEMPTS = max Coder retry count per CU before escalation to code lead (3 for this ITR). Colon label = section header with trailing colon (REQUIREMENTS:), the canonical form. Bare label = section header without colon (REQUIREMENTS), accepted as an alias per Designer decision. Legacy batch = no synopsis, every regular CU component-less; keeps one in-folder <cu-id>.itr frame and is never enforcement-failed.

REQUIREMENTS: Accept bare section labels (REQUIREMENTS, COORDINATES, IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS, ACCEPTANCE without trailing colon) as aliases of the colon labels in splitInlineSections, so Advisor batches drafted from the skill prose compile to four-file CU folders instead of silent legacy blobs. Mixed bare/colon batches split fully; partially-labeled batches keep failing loudly. This resolves bug-3 (bug-3-silent-blob-on-bare-section-labels) and all four feature criteria. COORDINATES: TYPE.scala.itrcompiler.infrastructure.parsers.JSONFormat.scala.JSONFormat + FILE.scala/itrcompiler/infrastructure/parsers/JSONFormat.scala + TYPE.scala.itrcompiler.domain.models.CU.scala.CU + FILE.scala/itrcompiler/domain/models/CU.scala; a coordinates value may name a DTR area that does not exist yet, meaning the CU creates it. IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS: (1) In itr-compiler/src/main/scala/itrcompiler/infrastructure/parsers/JSONFormat.scala, extend splitInlineSections (and CU.sectionLabels in itr-compiler/src/main/scala/itrcompiler/domain/models/CU.scala if that is where matching is anchored) so each bare label is an alias of its colon form; match colon forms first so a bare prefix never shadows a colon label. Explicit "components" object still wins; all-four-absent still takes the legacy single-frame path. (2) Keep validation agreement: missing-component detection reads the same label set, so partially-labeled batches keep failing loudly naming CU id + missing sections. Do NOT touch FileSystem.scala writer branches, Compile.scala orchestration, or YAMLFormat.scala (YAML inline splitting is a separate documented follow-up). Prove with: bug-3 CLI repro 1 (all-bare batch must yield four component files, exit 0), repro 2 (all-colon unchanged), repro 3 (mixed: two bare + two colon yields four component files), plus sbt "testOnly *JSONFormat*" from itr-compiler/ including a new bare-label parser test. Stop when feature tests T1-T4 are green; nothing beyond bare-label aliasing is in scope. ACCEPTANCE: Feature tests T1-T4: T1 — the all-bare batch from bug-3 compiles to <out>/cu-001/{COORDINATES,REQUIREMENTS,IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS,ACCEPTANCE}.itr with exit 0, no cu-001/cu-001.itr blob. T2 — the all-colon batch is unchanged (four files); a mixed bare/colon batch yields the same four-file folder. T3 — a two-section batch fails non-zero naming CU id + missing sections, no blob. T4 — sbt test from itr-compiler/ green including the new bare-label parser test. Commands: .LLMDD/tools/itr-compiler --compile --json-content <batch> --out-folder <tmp>/ plus sbt test from itr-compiler/.
